none: PAS LVPL-100DB6: Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constans
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is CONSTAN [ ] ; R/ is GLORIA EXERCITVS

A Roman copper alloy nummus of Constans dating to the period AD 337 to 341 (Reece Period 17). Reverse type GLORIA EXERCITVS, Two soldiers and one standard. The diameter is 13mm, and the weight is 1.1g. Obverse inscription is CONSTAN [ ] and the reverse inscription is GLORIA EXERCITVS
